1.mascotDialogue: One rule, no exceptions, güey — everything happens at the top! You go wanting to touch anywhere else, you don't want a stack.

2.mascotDialogue: `top` is the stack's whole memory of where it's standing! Minus one, empty. MAX minus one, full. Everything else — that's just that one número, getting moved around.

3.mascotDialogue: Look — the TOP marker, sitting on index 2, two empty slots still up there! That room to grow, that's the whole point, ándale.

4.mascotDialogue: The function did her job — she said no! The fault's all on the caller for not listening. That's why we always show the broken state honest, a slot right past capacity, out in the open — never quiet, never sneaky.
